outcome: Accuracy of ultrasonographic estimation of fetal head circumference (HC)
Factors affecting accuracy of HC estimation
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent ultrasound measurement of fetal HC
finding: Ultrasound estimation of fetal HC tends to underestimate actual HC, with the error increasing with advanced gestational age, low amniotic fluid volume, anterior placenta location, and instrumental vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The difference between sonographic and postnatal HC was related to mode of delivery, with the highest error seen in those who had instrumental vaginal delivery.
